g_12b0953fb5e5.title: Add a forced unit option to prettyBytes

links.evidence: Nov 2 ask: "`unit` has already shipped with the throw" refers back to the forced unit option built in the anchor conversation ("Let's add a `unit` option..."); the same `unit` artifact appears in both asks, so the change of plan continues that request.

anchorAsk.text: Let's add a `unit` option that forces the output unit instead of picking one automatically: `prettyBytes(1337, {unit: 'MB'})` → `0.00134 MB`, `prettyBytes(1337, {unit: 'B'})` → `1337 B`. It has to belong to the unit system that `bits`/`binary` select (so `KiB` only with `binary: true`, `Mbit` only with `bits: true`). A unit that isn't in the active system should throw a TypeError, same as the other option checks. Readme, types and tests too.

Next for pretty-bytes: a `significantDigits` option so callers can change the default rounding to 3 significant digits, e.g. `prettyBytes(1337, {significantDigits: 2})` → `1.3 kB` and `{significantDigits: 4}` → `1.337 kB`. It only applies when the fraction-digit options aren't set. Readme, types and tests as usual.
